lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: [VAR TRNAME(0000)], you did it!\nYou beat Giovanni, right?

That Archer guy made a run for it, so I chased
him all the way out here, and then...\c
all the Team Rocket Grunts ran right outta
Saffron City, too!
Guess we’re lucky you’re such a strong\nTrainer, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!

To be honest, I was a little scared.\c
Like, what would have happened to us if it
turned out the bad guys were the strongest,
you know?

But you and me, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]...
We really managed to save Silph!\c
Nobody will have to go through what Cubone
went through ever again!

All right! Now that everything’s back to normal,
I guess it’s time for the next Pokémon Gym!\c
Have you been to the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Saffron City Gym[VAR COLOR(0000)]
already, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]?\c
How many Badges have you got?\c
...That many, huh? Wow.
Maybe we’ll both make it all the way to\nthe Pokémon League!
Let’s both give it our best shot!\nSee ya!
